subject: Request: Exception for bundled ProServices + Premium Support (Clearstream)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@clearstreamhealth.com>
Date: 2025-11-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New request: Clearstream bundled ProServices + Premium Support - need approval path

Karthik / Monica —

Quick background: Clearstream (prospect-to-close in HS: HS-98421) is asking to bundle our ProServices onboarding (2-week custom integration scope) and 12 months of Premium Support into the enterprise contract at a blended per-month rate. They want the onboarding window expanded (4 onsite days + extended runbook deliverable) and an explicit SLA addendum for dedicated support hours during their migration cutover.

Proposal on table: 20% discount on list for the combined package, include one custom integration sprint (up to 60 engineering hours) and a 30-day post-go-live embedding tuneup. This is outside standard approved discount bands and adds nonstandard SOW language around dedicated weekly support during cutover.

Ask: Can we get an exec exception (Marissa) on the discount band and sign-off on the SOW redline for the custom integration scope? I attached the latest SOW and a pricing grid with the blended model. If we don’t get approval, Clearstream indicated they may need to split services across two vendors.

Attachments: SOW_Clearstream_v3.pdf, pricing_grid_clearstream.xlsx

Thanks — I'll summarize the financial impact below.

—Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@clearstreamhealth.com>
Date: 2025-11-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New request: Clearstream bundled ProServices + Premium Support - need approval path

Thanks Steph — I reviewed the numbers. Short summary for Marissa (please forward):
- ARR impact: $480K first year (hosted API + premium support), total contract value with PS: $620K.
- Proposed discount: 20% on the services line only (net new services value becomes $96K down from $120K).
- Cost / execution risk: 60 engineering hours for custom integration plus two dedicated support engineers during cutover (approx 40 support-hours). That constraint will require a temporary reallocation from the Dedicated onboarding backlog.

Risk note: The SOW currently includes a clause granting Clearstream a 24/7 support escalation during cutover window — legal flagged this as broader than our standard premium support. I added inline comments in the SOW PDF. If we keep the 24/7 language, margin compression increases by ~5% and our SLA exposure rises.

Operational ask: If Marissa okays the price exception, we need a signed commitment to a go-live date by Dec 15 and acceptance of a final runbook deliverable within 30 days post-go-live.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@clearstreamhealth.com>
Date: 2025-11-02T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: New request: Clearstream bundled ProServices + Premium Support - Exec exception requested

Marissa — forwarding the thread and attached SOW/pricing for an exec exception. TL;DR: Clearstream wants bundled onboarding + 12mo premium support at a blended discount. Deal economics look strong overall but this requires an exception to our discount cap and a narrow SLA addendum for the migration cutover.

Why I’m escalating: customer is strategic (regional payer with fast expansion in NE), competitive tension (they asked about splitting services), and legal requests nonstandard 24/7 cutover coverage. If we say no on discount or scope, they will likely walk to a competitor for PS.

Concrete ask: approve one-time discount on services up to 20% and delegate final SOW sign-off to Sales Ops with the following caveats:
- Remove permanent 24/7 SLA — limit elevated coverage to a 72-hour cutover window and cap out-of-scope engineering at 60 hours.
- Require go-live commitment by Dec 15, 2025 and a signed change order for any additional hours.

Attached: SOW_Clearstream_v3.pdf (with comments), pricing_grid_clearstream.xlsx

If you’d like a 10-minute sync, I can jump on a quick call this afternoon.

—Steph
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@clearstreamhealth.com>, Clearstream Legal <legal@clearstreamhealth.com>
Date: 2025-11-03T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exception for bundled ProServices + Premium Support (Clearstream)

Thank you for the clear summary. I approve the one-time 20% discount on the services line for this contract under the following conditions:
1) The 24/7 SLA language must be replaced with a defined 72-hour cutover window and a named escalation path limited to the two dedicated engineers we allocate.
2) Any work beyond the capped 60 engineering hours requires an approved change order and will be billed at standard PS rates.
3) Sales Ops (Karthik) to confirm resource allocation and notify CS leadership (Monica) of the temporary reassignment schedule.
4) Legal to accept the SOW redline removing open-ended SLA obligations.

Monica — please coordinate with Karthik on resource plan; Karthik, loop legal and upload the finalized SOW to the deal in HubSpot (HS-98421).

Steph — you have the approval; proceed to capture signatures and lock the Dec 15 go-live. Keep me posted on any material deviations.

Best,
Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
